guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster / Reverend / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Accurate: Corgan known for Stratocaster and later Reverend signature; Iha used Les Paul/various.

tone.target: clean arpeggiated alt-rock verse with subtle chorus and roomy reverb; light fuzzy lift in bigger sections
tone.profile: clean arpeggiated alt-rock verse with subtle chorus and roomy reverb; light fuzzy lift in bigger sections
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a mild boost and Chorus to enhance the clean arpeggios, followed by a classic Fender-style clean amp simulation (US Deluxe) paired with a roomy cab. A light Distortion is placed late in the chain for subtle lift during bigger sections.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal for arpeggiated clarity and sustain.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of a dedicated clean OD to maintain transparency.

alternatives.reason: For more even compression, but Boost is better for subtle lift.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required subtle, shimmering chorus effect for arpeggios.
Introduce a light, controlled fuzzy lift for bigger sections without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: Red Haze is chosen over Fuzz/OD to provide the necessary 'lift' texture while remaining subtle and non-dominant.

alternatives.reason: A safer alternative if Red Haze proves too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright tone of a classic Fender-style amp suitable for alt-rock.

alternatives.reason: Similar clean character, but US Deluxe is often preferred for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and articulate clean tone matching the US Deluxe amp.
Slightly scoop the mids and enhance clarity in the upper frequencies for arpeggios.
Provide the required spacious and roomy reverb for alt-rock atmosphere.

alternatives.reason: More metallic, but Room provides the desired natural space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the spacious alt-rock tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance roominess and vintage character for Smashing Pumpkins' alt-rock sound.
